required_input_schema.paper_exact_memory_circuits: JSON circuit instructions for every plotted code and physical-error point
required_input_schema.detector_error_models: versioned detector models derived independently from those circuits
required_input_schema.decoder_contract: algorithm, hyperparameters, stopping rule, and software/runtime versions
required_input_schema.sampling_plan: shots per point, seeds, confidence intervals, and fit protocol

forbidden_substitutions: guessed circuits, schedules, layouts, or benchmark metadata
acceptance_boundary: Generate every memory-curve point independently and validate uncertainty before comparing with the paper; printed curves are comparison-only.
